common.disclaimer: AI-assisted inferred profile — not a validated FACE-Q score.

landing.title: FACE-Q Conversation
landing.subtitle: A conversation about how things are for you, in your own words.

patient.invalidLink: This link is not valid or has expired. Please ask your care team for a new one.

language.title: Which language would you like to use?

adult.title: Before we start
body: This is a conversation with a computer program (an AI). It is not a doctor and does not give medical advice.
It will ask about how you feel about your face, your treatment and daily life. Your answers help your care team understand what matters to you.
What you say is saved with a study code, not your name. Your care team can read it.
You can skip any question, take a break, or stop at any time. Saying "skip" or "stop" works too.
adult.agree: I understand and I would like to continue
adult.decline: I do not want to continue

minor-assent.title: Hello! Before we chat
body: You are going to chat with a computer program. It is not a person and it is not a doctor.
It will ask how you feel about your face and how things are at school and with friends.
Your name is not saved. Your care team can read what you say so they can help you.
You can say "skip" if you do not want to answer something, or "stop" if you want to finish. That is always okay.
minor-assent.decline: I do not want to chat

guardian.title: For the parent or guardian
body: This is a conversation with a computer program (an AI) about how your child is doing. It is not a clinician and does not give medical advice.
It asks about your child's feelings about their face, daily life, school and friends. You can answer for your child, together with them, or let them answer with your support.
Answers are stored under a study code, without names. Your child's care team can read them.
You can skip any question, take a break, or stop at any time.
guardian.agree: I consent on behalf of my child and would like to continue

consent.declined: That is completely fine. You can close this page. Your care team will be in touch.

face.title: A few things about you
face.intro: This helps the conversation fit you. Everything can be changed.
face.displayNameHelp: A first name or nickname is fine.
face.readingComfort: How do you like to read and reply?
face.diagnosisTextPlaceholder: For example: nose surgery last month

chat.title: Conversation

psych.self_consciousness: how often it is on your mind

outcome.information: what you were told to expect

age.appraisal: how old your face looks to you

chat.failed: We couldn't send that. Please try again.
chat.halted: The conversation is paused. Your care team has been notified.
chat.paused: Whenever you're ready, just keep typing. This link will bring you back here.

mic.unsupported: Voice input isn't available in this browser. You can type instead.
mic.denied: Microphone access was blocked. You can type instead.
mic.error: Voice input stopped. You can try again or type.

summary.title: Did I get this right?
summary.intro: Here is a short summary of what you told me. You can correct anything.
summary.correctPlaceholder: For example: it's my chin that bothers me, not my nose

thanks.title: Thank you
thanks.body: Your care team will look at what you shared before your next visit.
thanks.close: You can close this page now.

patient.completed: This conversation is complete. Thank you.

screen.title: A few quick ratings
screen.intro: Tap a number for each one. 0 is the worst it could be, 10 is the best. There are no right answers — this just helps us know where to start.
screen.social: How you feel and get on with others
screen.missing: Please answer every item to continue.

signIn.title: Clinician sign in
signIn.sent: Check your email for a sign-in link.
signIn.notClinician: This account is not registered as a clinician.

participant.title: Participant
participant.focusNotePlaceholder: What do you most want to learn this time?
participant.linkOnce: This link is shown once. It is not stored; copy it or scan the code now.
participant.newParticipantIntro: Creating a new participant. The study ID is generated automatically.

session.title: Session review
session.aggregationTooltip: Domain severity = worst covered construct severity; with two or more constructs, the median is shown and the worst is noted. Confidence is the mean of construct confidences.
session.firstImpressionsIntro: What the patient said during the opening screen, before any topic was explored in depth.
session.facetsNone: No facets defined for this construct in the map.
session.unconfirmedReason: Explored but not confirmed back with the patient
session.deleteBody: This permanently removes the participant and all of their sessions, messages and profiles. Only the study ID is kept in the audit log.
session.noProfile: No profile has been generated for this session yet.
session.evidenceOnly: Evidence recorded so far (profile not generated yet)

instruments.title: Instruments
instruments.ingestIntro: Paste extracted instrument text. The proposal paraphrases constructs; item text is never stored.
